description: RA-CUSUM is a statistical monitoring method that plots the difference between the cumulative expected occurrence of an event (here, recurrence) and the actual observation, adjusting each patient's individual risk of surgical failure through a likelihood-based scoring method.
title: Risk-adjusted cumulative sum (RA-CUSUM) learning-curve analysis

description: The article argues, following Meehl, that a prediction is risky if it is unlikely to be true assuming the theory is false, and that non-zero regression-adjusted correlations are consistent with many competing theories positing stable personal and environmental characteristics.
title: Risky theory testing with experimental, falsification, and decay-model comparisons
